column3: The Day of the Game Tournament
We somehow made it to the day of the tournament...
As usual, Kirino, Kuroneko, Saori and I set off to Akihabara as a group.
By the way, you guys...
Everybody's sulking, what's with this gloomy atmosphere?
Wasn't that over a few days ago?
Isn't it about time their temper subsided?
Hey, you...
Eh? W-What is it?
I am reluctantly gracing you with my presence in this tournament. Don't you have anything to say to me?
H-Huh!?
I require gratitude as well as an apology.
Why must I do such a thing?
Isn't it obvious? Why are you so stubborn?
Could it be that you couldn't take it because I stole your brother?
W-What are you saying!? Impossible!
These two... Don't they know other ways to communicate?
Hahaha, both of you are really hyped up! We shall not lose either, Kyousuke-shi!
No... Besides, how is this hyped up?
Right in front of me pointing my finger--
Could you not decide things on your own?
Seriously, this chuunibyou-ridden girl is a real pain.
Hehe. People who have said that to me no longer exist in this world.
Say, isn't it about time you realized how miserable your existence is?
And who is always losing at Siscaly against said miserable existence?
Hng... If it's wasn't for me, you wouldn't be able to join this tournament either!
Furthermore, do you even have friends to team up with?
T-That's...
Here we are!
Aren't the four of us all gathered here as fellows with a common purpose!
Pfft, quite...
Isn't now the time for us to unite our strength? The objective is to capture the rare prize!
Hmph...
...I guess there's no helping it.
Phew... It seems like the situation has been defused.
Anyway, it seems like there's a lot of people.
Well, as long as there are prizes, collectors will definitely come.
Hoh... A lot of people have free time on their hands.
Even if it's for the rare prize, people wouldn't normally go this far, right?
I probably wouldn't understand even if I spent an entire lifetime thinking about it.
Not only collectors will come, but I'm afraid experts like Kuroneko-shi are also bound to gather here.
As a reminder, Siscaly is a 2 on 2 team battle, that's why teamwork is so important!
...Heh, that's just a mere human's perspective.
Kyousuke-shi should muster up some enthusiasm too!
...Y-Yeah.
You must win!
Must...? Well, I'll try my best...
Be sure not to pull me down. Be careful.
...Yeah～
On a side note, the teams are "Kirino & Saori" and "Kuroneko & I".
Kirino and Kuroneko would certainly quarrel if they were in the same group, so this arrangement seems obvious.
Oh, looks like it's about to start.
Looking in the direction Saori pointed, an official-like person walked towards the crowd.
It looks like the organizer sucks. An amateur?
In tournaments of this scale, organizers are normally like this.
Professional organizers tend to handle larger game tournaments.
So there are larger game tournaments?
Of course. For famous fighting games like "Siscaly", there are even enthusiasts-driven tournaments.
I think "Siscaly" has enough enthusiasts...
There are a lot of card game tournaments too.
So there are even such things. Amazing...
Oh? Does Kyousuke-shi wants to join this community from now on?
...Heh, kinda.
Though, well... I don't think it's a bad idea...
Somehow, I feel like I've been engulfed by the atmosphere of the place and my excitement is gradually raising.
This competition is a single-elimination tournament.
Which means, it's the end if we lose here.
...Hmph...
With that, everyone, let's do our best!
We'll definitely win.
Well, since I am here, the word defeat is irrelevant.
T-These guys are really into it...
All right, I also have to do my best!
I can't let the time spent on special training go to waste!
We must get that rare prize no matter what it takes--!
---Heh.
And thus the competition began--
Kirino and Saori's group advanced smoothly. As for our pair, although I was in trouble at times, thanks to Kuroneko, we were able to advance as well.
However--
Even when you consider her transcendental reaction time, it seems impossible to fight with such an incompetent partner.
Sorry, Kuroneko... I'm always dragging you down.
Since you're paired with me, it means we're riding the same Wyvern.
Isn't it "same boat"? But I'm counting on you.
...Yeah, I will protect you, Senpai.
And like that, we advanced into the semi-finals.
And then, here--
Oh?
Eh?
This is-- an unexpected situation...
Our opponents for the semi-finals ended up being Kirino & Saori!
What should we do? Have we no other choices than fight each other...
What should we do, Kuroneko?
Even if you ask me...
Putting me aside, letting them win might make it easier to win the finals...
But if we go easy on them in the battle...
Will the prideful Kuroneko permit such a plan?
Or will it be better if we have a serious match...?
